remediationChecklist.goal: Deploy or identify the remote staging websiteResolverServiceV1 endpoint.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_BASE_URL is set to a public HTTPS staging endpoint that is not localhost or private network.

remediationChecklist.goal: Provision resolver token through a secret manager or protected environment variable.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_TOKEN is set without exposing the raw token in repo files, logs, traces, or reports.

remediationChecklist.goal: Lock CORS to the approved NetSuite staging origin.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_ALLOWED_ORIGIN and IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_BLOCKED_ORIGIN are configured and W73R proves approved pass / blocked fail behavior.

remediationChecklist.goal: Run approved live-site smoke through the hosted endpoint.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: Approved live smoke passes with zero false-confident-wrong and zero unsupported claims.

remediationChecklist.goal: Run W73R and full preflight after remote config is present.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: W73R trace shows remoteSmokeExecuted true and preflight remains green.

remediationChecklist.goal: Run hosted-only consultant drawer smoke after W73R passes.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: Plan, Review, ROI / Competitive, Run, and Trace show concise hosted resolver status, evidence coverage, failure UX, and rollback behavior.

bestNextCodexPrompt.block: W75: Hosted Resolver Configuration Remediation Pack
bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W75: Hosted Resolver Configuration Remediation Pack. Use the W74 no-go decision to create the exact remediation package needed before consultant hosted resolver pilot traffic can be enabled: remote endpoint env setup, secret handling checklist, approved and blocked CORS origins, deployment owner checklist, W73R rerun command pack, no-secret trace rules, and pilot unlock criteria. Keep drawer and SuiteScript write-disabled, preserve N/LLM advisory-only, notes story-only, and blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout as insufficient evidence with no confident guesses. Output remediation pack, operator checklist, updated trace samples, W75 report, validator gates, and best next Codex prompt.
